title: Murder Begins at Home
summary: A man is found dead in the locked police station.
method: The killer witnessed the victim attempting to assault a girl so he strangled him. He threw away his wallet and phone but the victim wasn't actually dead. The victim used a playing card to lift the police station lock and get in. He was going to call for help when he had a stroke, for which the earlier strangling triggered.
motive: The killer and the victim already had a rocky relationship but seeing the victim attempt to assault the girl set him over the edge.
notes: If DI Mooney and Madeleine didn't discover the body together, I wonder if DI Mooney would've been a suspect.
